source: 建造一个塞博朋克风格城市。

image_prompt.text: A large distinct structure visible across the city - a megatower or a vast neon sign - that tells the player where they are
Walkable streets and alleys threading the blocks so movement through the city has an obvious grain
Composed views built to look good from specific vantage points along the streets

notes: Stage A landed on None: the prompt names a place and a style, not a game type, so no-genre was loaded and every routing axis stayed at its default.
Prompt is in Chinese; it translates as build a cyberpunk-style city. All handoff text is written in English.
A literal city may exceed the district band; if the user means a full metropolis rather than a few blocks, the frame has to be decomposed.

open_questions.ask: Is this a place to walk around and look at, or will a game be played in it later?
A few dense blocks, or a whole skyline you can travel across?

coverage_missing.ask: What do players do here - is it a showcase, a hangout, or the map for a game?
How much city - a few blocks or a whole skyline?
Do players go inside any of the buildings?

answers.ask: Is this a place to walk around and look at, or will a game be played in it later?
answers.answer: 先做成可步行探索和观赏的城市场景，不加入额外游戏玩法。

answers.ask: A few dense blocks, or a whole skyline you can travel across?
answers.answer: 采用几个高密度街区的小规模布局，重点呈现赛博朋克城市的街景与氛围。
